task.topic: Among randomized trials in people with COVID-19, what is the effect of ivermectin-containing treatment compared with placebo or standard care on all-cause mortality?

pico.population: People with COVID-19 enrolled in randomized controlled trials
pico.comparator: Placebo, standard care, or no additional experimental treatment
outcomes: All-cause mortality explicitly reported for a randomized arm at a source-defined follow-up

outcome.description: All-cause mortality explicitly reported for a randomized arm at a source-defined follow-up

candidate_capture_policy.record_scope: Record every source-supported randomized arm with explicit mortality events and outcome denominators; preserve multi-arm studies without manual aggregation.

targets.quantitative_use_policy: Extract explicit deaths and the outcome-table denominator for each randomized arm. A report that does not explicitly provide arm-level death counts is not quantitative extraction gold for this target.

extraction.model_selection_policy: Preserve every source-reported candidate; no study or effect selection occurs in extraction.
extraction.evidence_requirements: Transcribe only source-supported data, preserve exact evidence, and do not calculate, pool, choose an analysis record, or infer missing values.
